description: Nuage de points 3D des infrastructures ferroviaires is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Échantillon d'environ 2km de données LiDAR ferroportées en RGF93-CC44 / NGF-IGN69. Les données au format compressé LAZ peuvent être converties en LAS via l'outil et lues via la bibliothèque Pour plus d'informations, contacter l'équipe en charge des données 3D d'infrastrutures chez SNCF Réseau. Coverage: France. The portal files it under Réseau. Its keywords are Réseau, Infrastructure, 3D, Lidar, Données Topographiques. The portal shows 2017-04-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
